.1 yantram यन्त्रम्
Instrument, equipment or apparatus

ITA-9.6.6 yantram यन्त्रम्
Blunt surgical instruments, devices
The variety of blunt instruments and tools used in surgery.

ITA-9.6.40 yantradoṣaḥ यन्त्रदोषः
Defects of blunt surgical instruments
The 12 types of defects inherent in blunt instruments which makes them unsuitable for their respective purposes.

ITA-5.76.104 yānaklāntasya āsthāpanasya vyāpadaḥ यानक्लान्तस्य आस्थापनस्य व्यापदः
Condition caused by medicated decoction enema administered to person fatigued by travelling
A condition characterized by instantaneous emaciation of body.
